scope: First CCMNI data port: netdev registration, the transmit path to the MD, and what the MD does with data that arrives too early.

images.content: CCMNI netdev, transmit allowed as soon as HS2 is accepted
adds an explicit operator gate so the data path stays silent until enabled

vendor_reference.port: port_cfg.c: {CCCI_CCMNI1_TX, CCCI_CCMNI1_RX, DATA_TX_Q, DATA_RX_Q, 0xF0 | DATA_TX_ACK_Q, ...} as netdev ccmni0
vendor_reference.queues: DATA_TX_Q = DATA_RX_Q = 0 for MD_GENERATION >= 6293 (6297 here), shared with the system channel
vendor_reference.header: port_net.c pushes a CCCI header with data[0] = ccmni index, data[1] = total length including the header, reserved = 0

implementation.ccci-ccif-net-send: builds the net header on channel 22 queue 0 and reuses the shared transmit helper
implementation.ccci-md-net.c: one netdev ccmni0, bounded transmit queue drained by a workqueue (ndo_start_xmit is atomic while the CCIF transmit takes the owner mutex), RX skb built from the channel-20 payload, carrier and queue gated
implementation.dispatcher: channels 20/22 go to the netdev, HS2 arms it, faults abort it, stop and offline follow the generation

hardware_result.netdev: ccmni0 exists after boot with mtu 1500 and state DOWN
hardware_result.transmit_path: with the gate open and the interface up, the stack sent 4 frames (280 bytes) and the counters advanced: tx=4 tx_bytes=280 tx_busy=1
hardware_result.md_reaction: the MD asserted in mcu/service/hif/nccci/src/ccci_apis.c line 1574 with para=0x16 (22, the CCMNI TX channel): data arrived before its data path was ready
hardware_result.consequence: the generation was aborted, so the gate is now mandatory and defaults to off

second_run_with_gate_closed.netdev: hs2=1 opened=0 enabled=0, no transmit attempted
second_run_with_gate_closed.first_attempt: the FS service transmit failed with -74 (-EBADMSG) on queue 4 after 3610 transmissions and aborted the generation
second_run_with_gate_closed.re_run: the same image ran clean: dispatch state=4 error=0, services tx=4136 with only transient -EBUSY backpressure, no MD exception record
second_run_with_gate_closed.conclusion: the -EBADMSG is transient and did not reproduce; our ring validation is stricter than the vendor's and a concurrent MD control-word update can make one transmit fail. It is recorded, not papered over, and a retry would be the vendor-compatible behaviour if it recurs

not_claimed: any PDP context or IP traffic: AT+CGACT was never reached in a live generation
that queue 0 is the correct transmit queue for this MD; the assert leaves that open
that the -EBADMSG ring failure cannot recur
